summary: The Math class has square roots, powers, rounding, pi, and more. It is always available, so you never import it.
notes: Java has no ** operator. Use Math.pow(2, 10), which returns 1024.0 as a double.
(int) Math.ceil(students / 40.0) turns the double result back into an int.
Math.round() returns a long. Math.round(area * 100) / 100.0 rounds to 2 decimal places.
pitfall: Math.ceil(47 / 40) gives 1.0, not 2.0, because 47 / 40 is int division and is already 1. Write 47 / 40.0.
